Google's crawler reads TEXT only (not the logo image). So the homepage needs the literal text "Soul Pilates" prominently AND a clear sentence describing the site's purpose. ## The change (branch off the legal-pages branch so it's one deploy) Worktree/checkout from `origin/feature/legal-pages` (it already has the /privacy + /terms pages), branch `feature/site-legal-branding`. Soul Pilates

` or ensure existing name text is real, crawlable text). - Add a concise purpose sentence in the hero/intro, e.g.: "Soul Pilates is a boutique Pilates studio in Vietnam — book classes, manage your packages, and sign in to your account online." Read the site first to make it ACCURATE (reformer/mat? location? actual offering) rather than generic. Keep everything else intact. ## Verify + deploy + board - Build the staging frontend; verify https://staging.soulpilates.com.vn/ returns 200 and the page source contains the crawlable text "Soul Pilates" + the purpose sentence. Prod stays 200 throughout. - Commit to `feature/site-legal-branding`, push origin. Do NOT deploy to prod. Hand back the prod deploy command: `cd /opt/soulpilates && git fetch origin && git checkout main && git merge --ff-only origin/feature/site-legal-branding && scripts/deploy-prod.sh` (note: this branch also carries the /privacy + /terms pages + google-auth, all of which should ship together). - Add a "Claude" comment to the SP board card for the legal/privacy work (search the Soul Pilates board `cmsavfvil000hhla4nlpuyge6` for the "Privacy Policy & Terms pages" card) noting the homepage branding fix + the branch + deploy command.
